question: What color will the 2027 Pantone Color of the Year be?

calls.reasoning: Base rate from 27 past Pantone COTYs (2000-2026) mapped into the question's OKLCH buckets: about 4 each for Pink, Red, Orange and Purple; 3 Cyan; 2 each Blue and Green; 1 each Yellow, Gray, Brown and White. The last two picks were neutrals (Mocha Mousse in 2025, Cloud Dancer in 2026), which suggests a return to a chromatic color. Industry 2027 picks are mostly blues and greens (WGSN/Coloro Luminous Blue; Valspar, Glidden and Clark+Kensington blues; Sherwin-Williams, Dulux and Benjamin Moore greens) plus earth tones. Pantone hasn't picked a blue since 2020 or a green since 2017, so I gave those the most weight. Pantone's SS27 fashion report spans corals, reds, pinks and blues, which keeps the tails spread. No prediction market found on Polymarket, Kalshi, Manifold or bookmakers.
calls.dossier:
- Pantone had not announced its 2027 COTY as of 2026-11-02 (colorcombinations.org); it usually announces Dec 1-8, expected around 2026-12-03 (paletadecolores.org).
- Event window: Pantone's announcement of the 2027 COTY, expected early Dec 2026; the question is annulled if there is no announcement in 2026. As of 2026-11-08 nothing has been announced.
- Resolves off the hex of Pantone's 2027 COTY (the first-named color if there are several), converted to OKLCH and bucketed. Muted sage or olive greens still count as Green (hue 110-175); teal or aqua counts as Cyan (hue 175-230); light peach counts as Orange; coral with L>=0.55 and hue <30 counts as Pink; deep reds with L<0.55 count as Red or Purple depending on hue; Brown needs L<0.65, C<=0.12 and hue 25-80.
- Past COTYs mapped into these buckets (approximate, 2000-2026): Blue 2 (Cerulean 2000, Classic Blue 2020); Cyan 3 (Aqua Sky, Blue Turquoise, Turquoise); Green 2 (Emerald 2013, Greenery 2017); Yellow 1 (Mimosa 2009); Pink about 4 (Fuchsia Rose, Honeysuckle, Rose Quartz, Living Coral); Red about 4 (True Red, Chili Pepper, Marsala, Viva Magenta); Orange about 4 (Tigerlily, Sand Dollar, Tangerine Tango, Peach Fuzz); Purple about 4 (Blue Iris, Radiant Orchid (borderline Pink), Ultra Violet, Very Peri); Gray 1 (Ultimate Gray 2021); Brown 1 (Mocha Mousse 2025); White 1 (Cloud Dancer 2026, borderline on chroma). Never Black.
- The last two years were neutrals (brown, then near-white).
- 2027 picks from other companies (colorcombinations.org, as of Nov 2): WGSN+Coloro Luminous Blue (cobalt/lapis); blues from Valspar (Cottage Door), Glidden (Artifact, smoky aqua) and Clark+Kensington; greens from Sherwin-Williams (Celery), Dulux (Soulful Sage), Benjamin Moore (Webster Green) and Behr (Grounded, mossy olive); earth or brown tones from PPG, Dunn-Edwards, Little Greene, Dutch Boy (earthy orange) and C2 (rose-brown); pinks from Dulux Canada (Birthday Cake) and Graham & Brown (Rose Earth).
- Pantone NYFW SS27 report (fashionunited, Sept 2026) top 10: Anise Flower (whitened yellow), Princess Blue, Waterfall (blue-green), Langoustino (coral), Chili Pepper, Rosy Future (bright pink), Dragon Fire (orange), Daiquiri Green (lime), Hibiscus (red), Lavender Oil. Core neutrals: Antique White, Tarragon, Arrowwood, Blue Indigo, Dolphin.
- Pantone 2027 home palettes (giftsanddec): Delight, Allure, Lucid (blues/greens), Hush, Honest (warm browns/reds/oranges), Grounded (earth), Elation; theme of calm, comfort and joy.
- Pantone hasn't picked a blue since 2020 or a green since 2017.
- No prediction market found (searched Polymarket, Kalshi, Manifold).
- Searched for leaks or teasers of the 2027 Pantone COTY: none found.

calls.reasoning: As of Nov 2026 the 2027 color has not been announced; the reveal is expected in the first week of December. Prior: the 27 Colors of the Year from 2000 to 2026, sorted by hand into the question's OKLCH buckets: Red ~4-5, Pink ~4, Orange ~4, Purple ~3-4, Cyan 3, Blue 2, Green 2, and 1 each for Yellow, Brown, Gray and White. Updates: WGSN and Coloro named Luminous Blue as their 2027 color. Paint-brand 2027 picks lean heavily toward muted greens (sage, celery, Webster Green, olive) and blues, with some dusty pinks and browns. Pantone has not picked a green since 2017 and has been on soft, nearly neutral colors (Mocha Mousse, then Cloud Dancer), so a return to a stronger hue is plausible. Pantone often differs from WGSN's pick. No Polymarket, Kalshi or Manifold market was found. Light sky blues near hue 230 could resolve as Cyan instead of Blue.
calls.dossier:
- Status (colorcombinations.org, paletadecolores.org, as of ~Nov 2-6 2026): Pantone has not announced its 2027 Color of the Year. The reveal is expected around Dec 3, 2026, typically between Dec 1 and 8.
- Event window: announcement before the end of 2026 -> resolution Dec 3 2026. As of Nov 8 2026, no announcement.
- Resolves off the announced color's hex converted to OKLCH using the bucket rules, not off the color's name. Note: pale or sky blues with hue <230 resolve as Cyan. Pinks need L>=0.55 and hue <30 or >=340. A brown needs L<0.65, C<=0.12 and hue 25-80, so light beiges fall into Orange.
- WGSN + Coloro 2027 color: Luminous Blue (~#1C4286, deep cobalt/lapis), announced in 2025.
- 2027 paint-brand picks (colorcombinations.org): Valspar Cottage Door (grayed mid blue), Clark+Kensington Vantage Point (blue), Sherwin-Williams Celery (soft green), Benjamin Moore Webster Green (deep green), Dulux UK Soulful Sage (gray-green), Glidden Artifact (smoky aqua), Behr Grounded (mossy olive-brown), Dutch Boy Deep Rooted (earthy orange), Graham & Brown Rose Earth (dusty pink), Dulux Canada Birthday Cake (soft pink), C2 Pueblo (rose-mauve), PPG Country Soil (beige-taupe), Dunn-Edwards French Press Coffee (deep brown), Little Greene Marle (brown), Minwax Pickled Oak (light neutral).
- Pantone's own 2027 forecasts: the Home + Interiors 2027 palette themes are calm, comfort and 'respite and joy' (including a 'Hush' palette of muted midtones). Its NYFW Spring 2027 fashion report stresses 'boldness and refinement'.
- Blogger predictions (Kuitenbrouwer, Jul 2026): Naples Yellow, Matcha Green, Cool icy Blue. Other blogs list luminous blue, sage green, warm orange and pop pink.
- Recent Pantone sequence: 2024 Peach Fuzz (Orange bucket), 2025 Mocha Mousse (Brown), 2026 Cloud Dancer (off-white, White or near the threshold). Last green was 2017 Greenery; last blue was 2020 Classic Blue; last purple-bucket colors were 2022 Very Peri and 2018 Ultra Violet.
- Approximate bucket base rate over all 27 colors from 2000-2026 (computed by hand, unverified): Red 4-5, Pink 4, Orange 4, Purple 3-4, Cyan 3, Blue 2, Green 2, Yellow 1, Brown 1, Gray 1, White 1, Black 0.
- Pantone vs WGSN agreement history: 2024 Peach Fuzz vs WGSN Apricot Crush (similar); 2025 Mocha Mousse vs Future Dusk (different); 2026 Cloud Dancer vs Transformative Teal (different).

calls.reference_class: Pantone Colors of the Year 2000-2026 (27 colors), sorted by approximate OKLCH into the question's buckets

calls.reasoning: Prior: 27 Pantone COTYs 2000-2026 mapped into the OKLCH bins: Pink ~4, Red ~4-5, Orange 4, Purple 4, Cyan 3, Blue 2, Green 2, Yellow/Brown/Gray/White 1 each, Black 0. Updates: WGSN/Coloro chose Luminous Blue for 2027; paint-brand 2027 picks lean muted green and blue; Pantone has gone 9+ years without a green and 6 without a blue; the last two picks were neutrals (Mocha Mousse, Cloud Dancer), so a chromatic return is likely and Brown/White are down-weighted. Counter: Pantone often diverges from WGSN and paint brands, and pinks/reds/magentas are its most frequent historical bin, so the tails stay wide. No prediction market found.
calls.reconciliation: Runs agree closely (Blue 0.20-0.22, Green 0.17-0.20, Pink 0.10-0.13). The only factual dispute was historical bin counts (Pink 4 vs 5, Red 4 vs 4-5, Purple 3 vs 4). From memory of the hex codes: Radiant Orchid (hue ~335, below 340) is Purple; Marsala and Chili Pepper are Red because L<0.55; Living Coral sits on the Pink/Orange hue boundary near 30. So the counts are roughly Pink 4, Red 4-5, Purple 4. That doesn't move the prior much, and it can't be checked further without web access. Everything else is judgment over shared evidence (the WGSN blue, the paint-brand greens, the post-neutral swing). I kept Blue and Green as co-leaders with Pink third, and added a small boundary allowance for Yellow (olive greens with hue under 110) and Cyan (sky blues with hue under 230). No market exists to anchor on.
